miscompile_bugs.bug: Spinel returns empty `instance_methods(false)` for `SimpleCov::Formatter::JSONFormatter` even though the `format` method is defined directly in the gem's main entry file (not behind any ignored require), indicating Spinel drops public method definitions from a class body when other `require` calls in the same file are unresolved.

Spinel miscompiles `IPAddress.valid_ipv4?("192.168.1.1")` to return `false` instead of `true`; localized to ipaddress.rb:134 where `$~.captures.all? {|i| i.to_i < 256}` produces wrong result — `i` is read as integer 0 instead of the captured string "192".

codegen_bugs.bug: Spinel fails to compile TravisFormatter (which inherits XCPretty::Simple) because it does not support ForwardingSuperNode (bare `super` calls forwarding all args), aborting before C-code generation with "unsupported super (no parent method): node 22 (ForwardingSuperNode)".

codegen_bugs.bug: Spinel fails to compile `String#eql?` (or any generic `eql?` on a local variable of inferred type), exiting 1 with "unsupported call" before reaching the C stage, on perfectly ordinary Ruby code in RC4's key-blank check.
